svg.text: Where images come from, where yours go, and what PROD will accept
Catalogs — images the platform vouches for
DCS catalog — platform-provided and maintained. · allowed external — reviewed upstream images, mirrored in.
proxy-cached — pull-through for permitted sources, so the cluster still never reaches out mid-deploy.
green catalog — already CLEARED for production. The boring route into PROD, and usually the right one.
DEV namespace → its Harbor project
✓ takes PUSHES, of anything
✓ no CVE limitation
this is where a build's output lands
iterate, push a broken image, push it again
PROD namespace → its Harbor project
✗ takes NO pushes at all
✓ pulls only below CVE severity 9
no path in that skipped the review
unfixable finding? the exception process
Promotion = mirror between projects, same digest, requested through ITSM
Technically it is the skopeo copy you will run in this lab: read there, write here, nothing rebuilt and nothing unpacked.
What makes it a promotion is the process around it — and that the destination refuses every other route in.
A scan verdict belongs to a DIGEST, not a tag. That is why floating tags like :latest are refused — if the tag can move,
the thing that was scanned and the thing that runs are not provably the same bytes.
